notes: The policy references Addendum A for AGB percentages per hospital, which are not detailed in the text.
The policy mentions a third-party scoring tool for FPL calculation and income documentation requirements for the last 90 days, but these are procedural and not modeled as requirements or rules.
The policy allows SLV Health to utilize other sources of information for non-responsive patients to assess financial need, but this is discretionary and not a requirement for assistance.
The policy states that SLV Health will annually review and incorporate federal poverty guidelines updates, but this is a maintenance activity, not an eligibility condition.
The policy includes provisions for refunds if payments exceed the approved financial assistance rate and established copayment, but this is not modeled as a rule for granting assistance.
The policy specifies approval levels and record-keeping requirements, but these are administrative and not eligibility criteria.
The policy allows facilities to require re-application if new income level information becomes available, but this is not a condition for initial assistance.
